title: Open Agricola 玩家开局与对局情况

list.name: window
list.label: 开局统计窗口
list.query: 今日（UTC+8） : today,近24小时 : last_24h,近7天 : last_7d

list.name: cohort
list.label: 成熟注册批次
list.query: 近7天注册 : last_7d,近30天注册 : last_30d

panels.title: 永久开局记录启用时间
panels.description: 完整统计从此时间开始。更早的过期局没有足够证据，不倒推为零。新注册账号需要观察满 24 小时才进入转化率分母。

targets.expr: max((agricola_opening_tracking_since_unixtime) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120))) * 1000

panels.title: 开局数据采集状态
panels.description: 1 为采集成功，0 为失败。缺少或过期样本显示未知。账户注册采集与开局采集分别报告状态。

targets.expr: min(agricola_opening_collection_success) and on() (time() - max(agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime) < 120)

panels.title: 确认开局数
panels.description: 只统计永久开局记录启用后确认的开局，开发局不计入。今日按 UTC+8，24 小时与 7 天为滚动窗口。采集失败或超过 120 秒显示未知。

targets.expr: max((agricola_opening_games{window="$window",mode="all"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 去重开局账号数
panels.description: 只统计永久开局记录启用后确认的开局，开发局不计入。今日按 UTC+8，24 小时与 7 天为滚动窗口。采集失败或超过 120 秒显示未知。 按开局时入座的现存账号去重。同一账号多局、热座多个座位都只计一个账号；不代表线下实际人数。

targets.expr: max((agricola_opening_accounts{window="$window",mode="all"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 开局模式分布
panels.description: 只统计永久开局记录启用后确认的开局，开发局不计入。今日按 UTC+8，24 小时与 7 天为滚动窗口。采集失败或超过 120 秒显示未知。

targets.expr: max by(mode) ((agricola_opening_games{window="$window",mode=~"solo|hotseat|multiplayer"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 当前在线局阶段
panels.description: 至少有一个当前有效连接的局。按当前所有者 epoch、存活租约和就绪实例判断在线。开局包括选牌与轮抽；正式游戏单独展示。开发局不计入。

targets.expr: max by(stage) ((agricola_opening_current{mode="all",presence="online"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 离线保留局阶段
panels.description: 全员离线但仍可续局的存档。此数量不代表当前有人在玩，也不能单凭当前阶段认定玩家卡住。

targets.expr: max by(stage) ((agricola_opening_current{mode="all",presence="retained"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 已观察满24小时的新账号
panels.description: 按注册批次统计现存账号，仅包含记录启用后注册且已观察满 24 小时的账号。分子是在该账号注册后 24 小时内开局或进入正式游戏的账号数。分母为零时转化率显示未知。

targets.expr: max((agricola_opening_conversion{cohort="$cohort",milestone="eligible"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 24小时内开局转化率
panels.description: 按注册批次统计现存账号，仅包含记录启用后注册且已观察满 24 小时的账号。分子是在该账号注册后 24 小时内开局或进入正式游戏的账号数。分母为零时转化率显示未知。

targets.expr: (max((agricola_opening_conversion{cohort="$cohort",milestone="started_24h"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120))) / max((agricola_opening_conversion{cohort="$cohort",milestone="eligible"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))) and (max((agricola_opening_conversion{cohort="$cohort",milestone="eligible"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120))) > 0)

panels.title: 24小时内正式游戏转化率
panels.description: 按注册批次统计现存账号，仅包含记录启用后注册且已观察满 24 小时的账号。分子是在该账号注册后 24 小时内开局或进入正式游戏的账号数。分母为零时转化率显示未知。

targets.expr: (max((agricola_opening_conversion{cohort="$cohort",milestone="playing_24h"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120))) / max((agricola_opening_conversion{cohort="$cohort",milestone="eligible"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))) and (max((agricola_opening_conversion{cohort="$cohort",milestone="eligible"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120))) > 0)

panels.title: 24小时内开局账号数
panels.description: 按注册批次统计现存账号，仅包含记录启用后注册且已观察满 24 小时的账号。分子是在该账号注册后 24 小时内开局或进入正式游戏的账号数。分母为零时转化率显示未知。

targets.expr: max((agricola_opening_conversion{cohort="$cohort",milestone="started_24h"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 24小时内正式游戏账号数
panels.description: 按注册批次统计现存账号，仅包含记录启用后注册且已观察满 24 小时的账号。分子是在该账号注册后 24 小时内开局或进入正式游戏的账号数。分母为零时转化率显示未知。

targets.expr: max((agricola_opening_conversion{cohort="$cohort",milestone="playing_24h"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 等人开局耗时 p50 / p90
panels.description: 建房到确认开局。只包含已完成这段等待的局，正在等待的局不当成零秒。 至少 5 个样本才展示分位数。只统计永久开局记录启用后确认的开局，开发局不计入。今日按 UTC+8，24 小时与 7 天为滚动窗口。采集失败或超过 120 秒显示未知。

targets.expr: max by(quantile) ((agricola_opening_duration_seconds{window="$window",stage="waiting"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120))) and on() (max((agricola_opening_duration_samples{window="$window",stage="waiting"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120))) >= 5)

panels.title: 等人开局耗时样本数
panels.description: 建房到确认开局。只包含已完成这段等待的局，正在等待的局不当成零秒。

targets.expr: max((agricola_opening_duration_samples{window="$window",stage="waiting"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 选牌准备耗时 p50 / p90
panels.description: 确认开局到首次进入正式游戏。只包含首次时间均准确记录的局；旧存档恢复不会被算成首次正式游戏。 至少 5 个样本才展示分位数。只统计永久开局记录启用后确认的开局，开发局不计入。今日按 UTC+8，24 小时与 7 天为滚动窗口。采集失败或超过 120 秒显示未知。

targets.expr: max by(quantile) ((agricola_opening_duration_seconds{window="$window",stage="preparation"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120))) and on() (max((agricola_opening_duration_samples{window="$window",stage="preparation"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120))) >= 5)

panels.title: 选牌准备耗时样本数
panels.description: 确认开局到首次进入正式游戏。只包含首次时间均准确记录的局；旧存档恢复不会被算成首次正式游戏。

targets.expr: max((agricola_opening_duration_samples{window="$window",stage="preparation"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 同一开局批次的后续情况
开局批次当前结局
panels.description: 按所选窗口内开局的同一批局，观察当前正常完赛、协商结束、过期、下架与仍可续局的数量。仍可续局不算失败。

targets.expr: max by(outcome) ((agricola_opening_outcomes{window="$window",mode="all"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 开局批次当前完赛占比
panels.description: 分子与分母来自相同开局批次。包含尚未结束的局，因此是截至当前的完赛占比，不能视为最终完局率。

targets.expr: (max((agricola_opening_outcomes{window="$window",mode="all",outcome="completed"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120))) / max((agricola_opening_games{window="$window",mode="all"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))) and (max((agricola_opening_games{window="$window",mode="all"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120))) > 0)

panels.title: 开局座位数分布
panels.description: 只统计永久开局记录启用后确认的开局，开发局不计入。今日按 UTC+8，24 小时与 7 天为滚动窗口。采集失败或超过 120 秒显示未知。 展示开局配置的座位数，热座座位不等于独立账号。

targets.expr: max by(seats) ((agricola_opening_seats{window="$window"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 开局扩展使用情况
panels.description: 只统计永久开局记录启用后确认的开局，开发局不计入。今日按 UTC+8，24 小时与 7 天为滚动窗口。采集失败或超过 120 秒显示未知。 每个开关独立计数，同一局可以使用多个扩展，不能将各项相加作为总开局数。

targets.expr: max by(variant) ((agricola_opening_variants{window="$window"}) and on(job,instance) ((agricola_opening_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - agricola_opening_last_success_unixtime < 120)))

panels.title: 建房与入房系统错误
panels.description: 所选时间范围内的建房、入房和再来一局系统错误尝试。请求重试与重复回执不等于新增开局，规则拒绝单独展示。

targets.expr: sum by(command) (increase(agricola_commands_total{command=~"createRoom|joinRoom|newGame",outcome="error"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 建房与入房规则拒绝
panels.description: 规则拒绝可能来自座位已满或准入限制，应结合系统错误与真实开局数量判断。

targets.expr: sum by(command) (increase(agricola_commands_total{command=~"createRoom|joinRoom|newGame",outcome="rule_rejected"}[$__range]))
